title: Redstone Trainer
blurb: Learn Minecraft-style redstone from the ground up. Every circuit really runs, so you can flip levers, watch signals travel and build working machines.
learn: 22 components, 13 step-by-step mechanisms (logic gates, clocks, latches, piston doors, the Etho hopper clock, observer farms, slime block movers, flying machines and repeater-lock memory), build-it-yourself practice and 7 tests that point out missing or misused pieces.
controls: Tap or click a piece in the toolbar, then tap the grid to place it. Tap a placed piece again to rotate it. Use the hand tool to flip levers, press buttons and add hopper items.

title: Nova Strike
blurb: Pilot a starfighter through four alien sectors in full 3D. Blast through asteroid fields, canyons and crystal nebulas, then take down giant bosses.
learn: Lock-on missile combos, barrel rolls that bounce bullets back, four boss fights, a hangar of ships and upgrades, ranks to earn and an Endless mode.
controls: Mouse or WASD to fly. Hold left-click or Space to lock on, release to fire missiles. Shift or right-click to barrel roll. On phones: drag to fly, hold LOCK, tap ROLL.

title: Slime Forge
blurb: Merge matching slimes into stronger ones, beat bosses before the timer runs out, defeat the Slime God and ascend for permanent perks.
learn: Collect 15 kinds of slime, hunt for rare shiny mutations, fill the Slime Book and ascend to unlock new slimes.
controls: Drag a slime onto a matching slime to merge. Tap Spawn for more slimes. Tap the boss for bonus damage.

title: Dungeon Dash
blurb: Clear pixel-art dungeon rooms, pick from random power-ups and build a ridiculous combo before you face the Bone King.
learn: 20 power-ups from common to legendary, a boss every 5 rooms, and gold that buys permanent upgrades between runs.
controls: WASD or arrow keys to move, Space to dash. On a touchscreen, drag anywhere to move and tap DASH. Your knight aims and shoots on his own.

title: Neon Drift Royale
blurb: Drift around a glowing arena to charge your boost, then slam into rival racers to wreck them. Highest score after 90 seconds wins.
learn: Drift to charge boost, grab boost orbs, wreck 5 AI rivals and earn credits for new car colors in the garage.
controls: A/D or left/right arrows to steer. Hold Space while turning to drift, let go to boost. On a touchscreen, use the arrow and DRIFT buttons.

title: Mech Yard
blurb: Build a battle mech from scrap parts, then take on five giant bosses. Every win earns scrap for better legs, weapons and cores.
learn: Mix and match 3 leg types, 5 weapons and 3 power cores, then dodge shockwaves, lasers and drills to beat all five bosses.
controls: A/D or arrow keys to move, W, up arrow or Space to jump, E or Shift for your special. Weapons fire on their own. Touchscreen buttons appear on phones and tablets.

title: Gravity Golf: Galaxy
blurb: Mini golf across the planets. Slingshot your ball around gravity, dodge black holes, warp through wormholes and sink it in the cup.
learn: 12 holes with moving moons, black holes and wormholes. Earn up to 3 stars per hole and chase a hole-in-one.
controls: Drag back from anywhere and let go to launch. The dotted line shows where the ball will go.

title: Tower Titans
blurb: Place fire, ice, rock and lightning creatures along the path. They level up as they fight and evolve into Titans. Survive 25 waves on 8 different maps!
learn: 8 levels to unlock, 4 creature types with 3 evolutions each, a boss every 5 waves and the Gigaclops King at wave 25. Mix your elements to win.
controls: Pick a creature at the bottom, then tap or click the grass to place it. Tap a creature to evolve or sell it.

title: Lane Clash
blurb: Drop knights, archers, giants and dragons into two lanes and knock down the enemy towers before they knock down yours.
learn: 11 cards to collect and upgrade, trophies to climb, new cards to unlock and an AI opponent that gets tougher as you rank up.
controls: Drag a card from your hand onto your side of the arena, or tap a card and then tap the arena. Elixir refills over time.

title: Kaiju Rampage
blurb: Play as a giant monster. Stomp the city, blast it with atomic breath and eat tanks to grow big enough to crush skyscrapers.
learn: 3 cities, 8 monster sizes, a military that fights back with tanks, helicopters, jets and a giant robot, plus DNA upgrades and monster skins.
controls: WASD or arrow keys to move, Space to stomp, hold Shift or E for atomic breath. On a touchscreen, drag to move and use the STOMP and BREATH buttons.

title: Neon Serpents
blurb: Eat glowing orbs to grow into the longest serpent in the arena, and trap rival snakes so they crash into your tail.
learn: 16 rival serpents, a live leaderboard, boost to cut others off, and 8 skins that unlock as your best length grows.
controls: Point with your mouse to steer and hold the mouse button or Space to boost. On a touchscreen, drag to steer and hold BOOST.
